fig1_larmor_precession.svg: A spin-$\frac12$ tilted $55^\circ$ from $B=B_0\hat z$, evolved under $H=-\gamma B\cdot S$ by the module's spin_expectations. $\langle S_z\rangle=\frac\hbar2\cos\alpha$ is constant while $\langle S_x\rangle,\langle S_y\rangle$ trace a circle -- the spin precesses on a fixed cone at the Larmor frequency $\omega=\gamma B_0$ (here $6$), period $2\pi/\omega$. This level splitting $\hbar\omega$ is the NMR/ESR resonance.
fig2_rabi_oscillations.svg: Upper-level probability $P_\uparrow(t)$ from the module's rabi_probability for drive $\Omega=1$ at three detunings $\Delta$. On resonance ($\Delta=0$) the population fully inverts every $t=\pi/\Omega$ ($\pi$-pulse); off resonance the flop never completes, saturating at $\Omega^2/\Omega_R^2<1$ and oscillating faster at the generalized Rabi frequency $\Omega_R=\sqrt{\Omega^2+\Delta^2}$ -- the engine of magnetic resonance and single-qubit gates.
